userStories.title: Add helpers and pill row to SessionItem; export SessionItem
userStories.description: As a mobile session-list user, I want each session row to show the agent's flavor icon, abbreviated model code, and permission-mode badge so I can identify the running agent at a glance without opening the drawer.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/happy-app/sources/components/SessionsList.tsx gains a pure helper formatModelCode(code: string | null | undefined): string | null that returns the last `-`-segment when it matches ['codex','opus','sonnet','haiku'], otherwise the raw code (capped at ~12 chars).

packages/happy-app/sources/components/SessionsList.tsx gains a pure helper permissionColorForCode(code, theme): string with explicit switch mapping acceptEdits/bypassPermissions/plan/read-only/safe-yolo/yolo/default to theme.colors.permission.* (mirrors AgentInput.tsx:1387-1396). Falls back to theme.colors.textSecondary for unknown codes.
SessionItem (line 342) is exported via `export const SessionItem = React.memo(...)`. No other export changes.

SessionItem renders a pill-row View between the subtitle Text (lines 436-438) and the statusRow View (lines 440-450). The pill row container is rendered ONLY when at least one of session.flavor, session.currentModelCode, session.currentPermissionModeCode is non-null/non-empty.
testID='session-role-pill-flavor' pill renders an expo-image Image with source=newSessionAgentIcons[flavor], inline size { width: 12, height: 12 }, shown only when session.flavor matches a known key.
testID='session-role-pill-model' pill renders Text with formatModelCode(session.currentModelCode), shown only when session.currentModelCode is non-null.

testID='session-role-pill-permission' pill renders Text with the raw session.currentPermissionModeCode, colored via permissionColorForCode(...), shown only when session.currentPermissionModeCode is non-null.

Pill row container style: flexDirection:'row', alignItems:'center', gap:6, marginTop:4, overflow:'hidden'. Each pill: flexShrink:1, minWidth:0, height:20, paddingHorizontal:6, borderRadius:6. Pill text: numberOfLines={1}, ellipsizeMode:'tail'.
sessionItem style height is bumped from 88 to 108 in the unistyles block at the end of the file.
All new styles live in the existing stylesheet = StyleSheet.create((theme) => ({...})) block (project convention — styles at end of file).
React.memo call on SessionItem remains without a custom comparator (default shallow compare).
